rule: Every calm visible path must map to backend records before production work starts.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, escrow, deposit, payout, booking commission, or rental money custody in phase one.
release_goal: Keep the public UI calm while showing the account, listing, proof, lead, money, and market records that the backend must eventually store.

buyer.purpose: Store the selected machine, buyer note, region, urgency, and supplier route.
Store trust score, proof count, document visibility, and availability state at enquiry time.
Store copied enquiry text, supplier channel, response target, and follow-up state.
Store that rental payment stays supplier-direct with 0% rental take.

supplier.purpose: Store company profile, service regions, contact desk, and listing plan.
Store category, make, model, location, availability, rate notes, and public status.
Store photos, license, insurance, inspection, operator proof, and expiry dates.
Store active listing count, USD 9/month or USD 99/year plan, renewal state, and no rental custody rule.

founder.purpose: Store suspicious listings, proof gaps, approval status, and founder support notes.
Store country, category, demand, supply, proof, and ARR readiness.
Store supplier hunt targets, call status, proof ask, and activation path.
Store version, test focus, production gaps, and next build.

ui_principles: Show one calm public route before exposing build layers.
Use data room records as implementation memory, not as extra visual noise.
Keep buyer and supplier screens focused on one next action.
Make founder controls explain what to build next without scaling complexity.
acceptance: Marketplace shows the Calm Data Room after the Calm Focus Lens and before the Serene Route Planner.
Buyer path maps to direct enquiry, proof snapshot, lead packet, and payment guardrail records.
Supplier path maps to account, listing, proof document, and listing subscription records.
Founder path maps to admin review, market wedge, supplier target, and release gate records.
Copy text states 0% rental take and supplier-direct rental payment.
Build Phase shows v156 Calm Data Room as the current version.
Static check verifies the data room UI, contract, and JSON model.
